subject: Implementation gateway & training burn-up plan — Vertex Health MAP
content:
From: Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@vertexhealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps after signature — MAP items for rollout

Hi Laura,

Thanks again — excited to get started. Per our legal/ops team, we need the implementation plan embedded in the MAP to call out:
- A narrow canary window (3 days) and rollback criteria
- Migration cutover checklist (data sync, dual-write validation)
- Training schedule for 4 internal teams (CS, Ops, Security, Product)
- Evaluation plan: acceptance tests and token-cost targets for P0 flows

Can you confirm proposed dates and attach the latest MAP draft so our PM can annotate it? Also: our procurement wants the go-live acceptance criteria included in the MAP (not a separate doc).

Best,
Sara
Sara Bennett
VP Product | Vertex Health

---
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@vertexhealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation gateway & training burn-up plan — Vertex Health MAP

Sara — thanks, this is helpful. Attached is a draft MAP with the post-signature implementation plan baked in (vertex_map_v1.pdf). High-level summary below; details are in the MAP and the canary checklist (attached).

Plan summary (embedded in MAP):
1) Rollout windows
   - Canary phase: Aug 20–Aug 22 (72-hour active window).
   - Gradual regional ramp: Aug 23–Sep 5 (20% → 50% → 100% traffic cadence).
2) Canary & migration mechanics
   - Pre-canary: data sync verification (dry-run) on Aug 15–16; dual-write enabled Aug 19 00:00 UTC.
   - Canary validation: live traffic with telemetry gating; automatic fallback to previous model variant on threshold breach (>3% error rate or lat increase >250ms P95). See canary_checklist.xlsx.
3) Training & enablement
   - Train-the-trainer sessions: Aug 10 and Aug 14 (2-hour sessions).
   - Team-specific runbooks delivered Aug 18; office hours Aug 23–25.
4) Evaluation & acceptance
   - Acceptance tests: synthetic throughput + 500 sample prompts from your P0 set.
   - Cost targets: token/unit cost must be within 12% of pilot baseline during ramp.

Ask: please confirm that Aug 10 for the first trainer session and Aug 20 as the canary start work for you. If so, we'll lock in canary runbooks and schedule the two training sessions in Confluence.

Attachments:
- vertex_map_v1.pdf (MAP draft with embedded plan)
- canary_checklist.xlsx (detailed gates & metrics)

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0118

Laura — we can reserve a Dedicated pool with a written burst policy. Proposed spec: 4x A100-equivalent nodes (reserved) + 2x burst nodes for the first 72 hours of canary. We'll tag the pool for deal DEAL-8932 and set autoscale thresholds to avoid noisy neighbor interference.

- Pre-canary dry-run will run on Aug 15 with a controlled 10% traffic injection; ops will monitor KV cache efficacy and per-token latency.
- If rollback needed, the router policy will flip to the prior model variant and revert resource allocation within 15 minutes.

I'll drop the exact pool IDs and cost estimate by EOD today.
